core_question: Can NIO turn multi-brand EV scale and battery-swap/service differentiation into durable owner earnings?
decision_reason: Operating improvement is real, but Q2/Q3 margin and cash-flow proof are still missing.
upgrade_trigger: Vehicle margin remains mid-teens or better while operating cash flow improves after ONVO/FIREFLY mix rises.
downgrade_trigger: Vehicle margin cracks, delivery growth is discount-driven, inventory/payables worsen, or geopolitical risk escalates.
